description: Same hyperparameters as baseline under a different random seed — a replication check, not a hyperparameter sweep entry.
Default hyperparameters from TrainingConfig, unmodified — the control run every other experiment is compared against.
5x the baseline learning rate — tests whether faster value updates speed convergence or destabilize training.
10x smaller than baseline — tests whether slower updates improve final policy stability at the cost of convergence speed.
More myopic than baseline (0.99) — tests whether heavily discounting future reward degrades long-horizon pricing behavior, e.g. holding price too long near the deadline.
5x fewer episodes than baseline — establishes how much of baseline's performance is achievable within a much smaller training budget.
